    BO13a Lemma 7: the contour paths are short #

    For a long σ, a non-long ρ ≤ σ with the same domain (a valley), a long μ ≠ σ forming a peak with ρ, and a contour (α v', β w') of σ with ρ through α, the trees of BO13a figure 7.2 (in P/μ) force v' to have two arrows and w' at most three (MulBasis.l7_short).

    • RayCat.exists_max_prefix: a longest prefix through which a morphism factors.
    • RayCat.prefix_cross: proper prefixes of the two paths of a contour are incomparable.
